nodes.label: notificaciones :: campana
nodes.rationale: T3 notification bell for public and admin bars. Filled by main.js inicializarNotificaciones via GET /api/notificaciones every 60 s (polling, no WebSocket), paused when tab hidden. Unread count in aria-label and visible number (not just a colored dot); sections for active offers and best sellers. Texts resolved server-side in active language.
